name: TinyCThread
listed_description: Portable, small implementation of the C11 threads
reason: README and repo root (README.txt, source, test, doc) contain no benchmark or performance numbers against pthreads, Win32 threads or any other library; no third-party comparison found.

name: TLSF
listed_description: Two-Level Segregated Fit memory allocator, a general purpose dynamic memory allocator.
reason: Repo has only README.md, tlsf.c and tlsf.h; README lists O(1) cost, 4-byte overhead and low fragmentation but no numbers or malloc comparison. Derivatives (sysprog21/tlsf-bsd, minad/tlsf) also carry no glibc numbers. Numeric TLSF vs malloc results found only for other implementations (rlsf, a .NET port) or in the original TLSF paper, which could not be opened.

name: transwarp
listed_description: A header-only C++ library for task concurrency.
reason: README, CHANGES.md and examples/benchmark_simple.cpp and benchmark_statistical.cpp (which time plain function calls against a transwarp graph) publish no timing numbers; searches found no third-party benchmark including transwarp.

name: Valgrind
listed_description: Range of dynamic analysis tools, including a leak checker.
reason: Valgrind is itself the baseline named for the profilers category and slows programs; no claim of being faster than gprof or perf is known. valgrind.org and sourceware.org were unreachable (ENOTFOUND) and no GitHub mirror was opened, so no numbers were available.
